name: 92807 · Anaheim, CA
findings: ZIP 92807 (Anaheim) has 182 nonprofit organizations. 74 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 61 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92807 (Anaheim) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 17 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
